context_length: Trained on crops of up to 1,024 residues; longer sequences are embedded whole here
summary: Meta's 650M-parameter masked protein language model; the most widely used general-purpose PLM and a strong, well-validated baseline for embedding quality.
architecture: Encoder-only BERT-style transformer (33 layers, 1280 hidden, 20 attention heads) with rotary position embeddings. Per-residue outputs are the final hidden states; this benchmark mean- or attention-pools them.
pretraining_data: UniRef50 representative sequences (~65M clusters), sampled during training from the broader UniRef90.
key_innovations: Evolutionary-scale masked LM whose attention maps recover residue–residue contacts
Backbone of ESMFold for single-sequence structure prediction
Family spans 8M–15B params; 650M is the standard quality/cost sweet spot
when_to_use: A reliable default and comparison anchor: strong single-sequence embeddings at moderate cost, extensively benchmarked across function and structure tasks.
caveats: Single-sequence only (no MSA/retrieval), no explicit structure or function conditioning.

citations.title: Evolutionary-scale prediction of atomic-level protein structure with a language model
